explanation: The Lumière brothers launched Autochrome colour plates in 1907, using dyed grains of potato starch. James Clerk Maxwell showed a colour photograph as early as 1861.

claims.text: Colour photographs were being made before the First World War began in 1914.
The Lumière brothers put Autochrome colour plates on the market in 1907.
Autochrome plates used microscopic grains of potato starch dyed in different colours.
James Clerk Maxwell demonstrated a colour photograph in 1861.
